title: The Three Concentric Zones of the Cosmos
description: When the Living Spirit built the cosmos he hung three concentric Zones, one within another: the innermost girdle contains the five powers of Darkness as captives; the middle girdle is the Five Sons of the First Man fettering the enmity within themselves; and the outermost girdle is the firmament above where the King of Honor sustains the whole structure. In the present cosmic state, evil exists only as something fettered inside good, accounted for and held within the Living Soul.
